title: Staff can send each new member a personal welcome from the Resonance CRM roster

source.ref: Owner request 2026-11-17 (project thread): personally message each new member from Resonance CRM

detail: Daniel wants to welcome every new member himself, by hand, from Resonance CRM. Built: every member with no welcome on record (owner ruling 2026-11-17: everyone not yet welcomed, lib/crm/welcome.ts) carries a glowing Say hi mark on the platform roster rows and cards (/admin/crm and /admin/crm/members; never a Space roster), and a Send a welcome button atop their pane. It opens the member composer on a pre-filled, editable welcome in Daniel's voice, pinned to that one member. Send rides the ordinary gated 1:1 send (sendMemberMessageAction -> sendNowAction), so consent and suppression apply, then logs one personal_welcome row in the existing sent-email ledger (lifecycle_send_log, unique per member) so the glow clears. Already said hi logs a welcome sent some other way under an address the cap never reads. Nothing is ever sent automatically. No migration.

verify.note: Fails on main: no welcome flag on the roster, no pop-up, no welcome record. Passes once all are wired.
